title: 第216章 音魔归一悟真道双力交融固渊封第215章 清音受困遭魔噬众仙浴血护残封
content_zh:
第216章音魔归一悟真道，双力交融固渊封
大乔与西施对视一眼，二人默契合力催动水系功法。
【鲤跃之潮】自沟壑魔水中汲取水流，层层水幕堆叠向前推进。
【绝断之桥】在半空构筑连绵水壁，试图隔绝黑雾继续向内挤压。
漆黑魔气碰到水面，立刻发出“滋滋”刺耳声响，水体迅速发黑腐化，没过多久，厚重的水壁便被侵蚀出无数孔洞。
妲己身形化作一道粉色流光，不断在黑雾外围游走。
【偶像魅力】光球接连绽放，想要扰乱魔渊本源的意识，可本源乃是万千负面情绪凝聚而成的太古存在，寻常幻术根本无法撼动其心智。
粉色光球触碰到黑雾，顷刻间便被狂暴魔气吞噬消解，连一丝涟漪都无法掀起。
蹲在一旁的梦奇扇动翅膀全速上前，圆滚滚的身躯鼓起，【食梦涤浊】全力运转，大口大口吞噬向外逸散的浊气与负面怨息。
短短片刻，小家伙一身雪白绒毛被染成暗沉的灰紫色，气息愈发疲惫，却依旧不肯后退半步，奋力为众人减轻压力。
祭坛外围，墨衍正与魔渊本源分出的黑雾分身激烈缠斗。
黑红交织的魔元与漆黑雾流不断碰撞，狂暴冲击波席卷四方黑石，地面不断崩裂出崭新沟壑。
他一心二用，一边抵御源源不断袭来的黑雾攻击，一边时刻留意封印屏障方向，见到蔡文姬被困，眼底顿时涌上浓浓的焦灼。
“孽障！休要伤我女儿！”
墨衍一声沉喝，不惜燃烧自身多年积攒的魔元底蕴，周身黑红光幕骤然膨胀，硬生生震退身前黑雾分身。
他不再犹豫，舍弃缠斗，化作一道流光冲破重重黑雾阻拦，直奔被围困的蔡文姬而去！
魔渊本源察觉到他的动向，立刻调动数道粗壮漆黑雾鞭横空拦截。
雾鞭带着毁天灭地的威势抽打而来，墨衍咬牙将魔元尽数凝聚在双臂之上，硬扛数次重击。
黑色魔气不断啃噬他的护体灵光，衣袍寸寸碎裂，皮肤上浮现出大片发黑的纹路。
他强忍神魂被侵蚀的痛楚，终于冲破阻拦，抵达蔡文姬身旁。

“姬儿，稳住心神！不要抵抗魔气！”墨衍高声呼喊，声音穿透轰鸣不断传入蔡文姬耳中！
“清音与魔元本出同源，墨渊血脉承载二者平衡，强行对立只会让你经脉崩碎！试着引导两股力量相融！”
深陷痛苦之中的蔡文姬意识恍惚，耳边无数杂乱低语不断诱惑她放弃抵抗。
无数幻境画面在识海轮番闪现：望海城苦战倒下的将士、万宗大会遭受的讥讽质疑、青螺山血战遍地的伤痕……
负面情绪如同潮水想要淹没她的道心，可墨衍的话语不断回荡，她脑海之中猛然浮现清音分舵玉册记载的秘闻。
墨渊以身镇渊，同时容纳清音血脉与渊底魔气，依靠的便是音魔同源的根本奥义。
长久以来，她一直默认清音净化魔气，将二者视作天生对立，却忽略了最核心的真相！
那就是魔气不是原罪，失控的欲望与怨念，才是浩劫的源头。
“音魔同源……相融共生……”

蔡文姬低声喃喃，咬紧牙关压下经脉撕裂般的剧痛。
content_en:
Chapter 216 The sound demon Guiyi realizes the true way, and the two powers merge into Gu Yuanfeng
Da Qiao and Xi Shi looked at each other, and they worked together in tacit understanding to activate the water-based skills.
[Carp Leap Tide] draws water from the ravine magic water, and layers of water curtains are stacked to push forward.
[Bridge of Cutoff] builds a continuous water wall in mid-air, trying to isolate the black mist from continuing to squeeze inward.
When the dark demonic energy hit the water, it immediately made a harsh "sizzling" sound, and the water quickly turned black and corrupted. It didn't take long for the thick water wall to be eroded and countless holes were formed.
Daji's body turned into a pink stream of light, constantly wandering around the black mist.
[Idol Charm] The light balls bloomed one after another, trying to disrupt the consciousness of the origin of the devil, but the origin is an ancient existence condensed by thousands of negative emotions, and ordinary illusions cannot shake its mind at all.
The pink ball of light touched the black mist and was instantly swallowed up and dissipated by the violent demonic energy, unable to create even a ripple.
Meng Qi, who was squatting aside, flapped his wings and moved forward at full speed, his round body bulging, and [Dream Eater and Purifier] operating at full strength, swallowing the turbid air and negative resentment that escaped outwards.
In just a short moment, the little guy's snow-white fur was dyed a dull gray-purple. His breath became more and more tired, but he still refused to take a step back, struggling to relieve everyone's pressure.
Outside the altar, Mo Yan was fighting fiercely with the black mist clone that was separated from the origin of Moyuan.
The black and red demonic elements continuously collided with the jet-black mist. Violent shock waves swept through the black rocks in all directions, and the ground continued to crack and create new ravines.
He was multitasking, resisting the incoming black mist attacks while always paying attention to the direction of the seal barrier. When he saw Cai Wenji trapped, his eyes suddenly filled with anxiety.
"Evil! Don't hurt my daughter!"
Mo Yan shouted deeply, without hesitation in burning the demonic essence he had accumulated over the years. The black and red light curtain around his body suddenly expanded, and the black mist clone in front of him was forced to retreat.
He no longer hesitated, gave up the fight, turned into a stream of light and broke through the heavy black fog, heading straight for the besieged Cai Wenji!
Moyuan Origin noticed his movements and immediately mobilized several thick jet-black mist whips across the sky to intercept him.
The fog whip came with the power of destroying the heaven and the earth. Mo Yan gritted his teeth and concentrated all the demonic energy on his arms, and withstood several heavy blows.
The black demonic energy continued to eat away at his body-protecting aura, his robes were torn apart, and large black lines appeared on his skin.
He endured the pain of his soul being eroded, and finally broke through the obstruction and arrived at Cai Wenji's side.
"Jier, calm down! Don't resist the evil spirit!" Mo Yan shouted loudly, and the sound penetrated the roar and continued to reach Cai Wenji's ears!
"Qingyin and Demonic Yuan originate from the same source, and Mo Yuan's bloodline carries the balance between them. Forcing a confrontation will only cause your meridians to collapse! Try to guide the two forces to merge!"
Cai Wenji, who was in deep pain, was in a trance, and countless murmurs in her ears kept tempting her to give up resistance.
Countless phantom scenes flashed in turn in the sea of ​​consciousness: the fallen soldiers in the bitter battle in Wanghai City, the ridicule and doubts suffered by the Ten Thousand Sects Conference, the scars everywhere in the bloody battle on Qingluo Mountain...
Negative emotions were like a tide that wanted to flood her Taoist heart, but Mo Yan's words kept echoing, and the secrets recorded in the Qingyin Branch Rudder Jade Book suddenly appeared in her mind.
Mo Yuan used his body to suppress the abyss, and at the same time accommodate Qingyin's bloodline and the abyss's demonic energy. He relied on the fundamental secret that the sound and demons had the same origin.
For a long time, she has always defaulted to pure sound to purify demonic energy, treating the two as natural opposites, but ignored the core truth!
That is, demonic energy is not original sin, but out-of-control desires and resentments are the source of catastrophe.
"Sounds and demons have the same origin... blend and coexist..."
Chapter 216 The sound demon Guiyi realizes the true way, and the two powers merge into Gu Yuanfeng
Cai Wenji murmured in a low voice, gritting her teeth to suppress the severe pain that felt like tearing through her meridians.
